head: 2aadddf261a97192e1c1e367606067d4638e79aa

findings.summary: `folder::default_kernel` reads `.ganymede.toml` from outside the server root: it checks only for `..` components and symlink_metadata on the final file, so a symlinked directory component (root/a -> /elsewhere) is followed and `dir` values with `\` or a drive prefix (`..\..`, `C:/x`) escape the root on Windows. The contents API refuses the same paths (resolves_under, ApiPath::parse); the docs say it never reads above the root.

notes: The posted pass was on 2aadddf; the finding was verified on a3999a7 (a review-fix commit on top).
